subject: URGENT: You are hired! Pay onboarding fee to start
body: Congratulations!!! You have been SELECTED for a remote position with a salary of $8000/week. No interview required. To secure your spot, please pay a small onboarding fee of $250 via gift cards and send your bank account and SSN immediately. Act now, this offer expires in 2 hours!
